policy: Candidates are inventory only until install/import/startup, real-input exercise, validation, provenance, and failure/resume evidence are recorded.

candidates.whyRelevant: Studio workflow layer for project management, DCC integrations, publishing and modular pipeline extensions.
candidates.smokeTest: install; launch CLI/runtime; create isolated project; publish a test asset; retrieve published identity
candidates.artifactExpected: published asset/version record plus machine-readable run evidence
candidates.fallback: Kitsu/AYON/OpenAssetIO plus existing deterministic artifact manifests
candidates.promotionGate: real publish/retrieve round trip with version/license evidence

candidates.whyRelevant: Open-source asset/publishing foundation and historical lineage for modern VFX pipeline systems.
candidates.smokeTest: install/import core; create isolated asset hierarchy; publish and resolve a version
candidates.artifactExpected: resolved asset/version identity and provenance record

candidates.whyRelevant: Pipeline framework patterns for production data, workflow, naming and revision control.
candidates.smokeTest: verify upstream license/version; run minimal pipeline bootstrap; create and resolve a revisioned test item
candidates.promotionGate: upstream evidence plus isolated end-to-end revision exercise

candidates.whyRelevant: Agent-oriented pipeline manifests, tool registry, checkpoints, review gates and FFmpeg/Remotion composition patterns.
candidates.smokeTest: run contract tests; inspect tool registry; execute a local no-key pipeline against test media; validate ffprobe/frame/audio gates
candidates.artifactExpected: pipeline manifest, checkpoint state, decision log and validated test video
candidates.fallback: existing GitHub Actions + OTIO + FFmpeg pipeline
candidates.promotionGate: contract tests plus real local media pipeline with resumable checkpoint evidence

candidates.whyRelevant: Current OpenUSD release line provides the interoperable scene-description backbone for assets, composition, lighting and future Hydra render integration.
candidates.smokeTest: install current stable release; author a USD stage; compose references; reopen and validate stage metadata
candidates.promotionGate: round-trip scene test and versioned schema evidence
